verdict: One likely product bug (quantity not clamped to stock) and one WAF 403 block; the two goto timeouts passed on retry. Together with the 403, the local target at localhost:3100 looks unstable.

failures.test: Product info › quantity cannot go above the stock of the selected variant
failures.summary: Typing 99 into the quantity field and blurring does not clamp it to the stock of 12 for Sage S. The stepper does disable the increase button.
failures.evidence: Expected: "12" Received: "99" (stable over 24 checks, both attempts); snapshot: textbox "Quantity": "99" next to button "Increase quantity" [disabled] and paragraph "12 In Stock".
failures.next_step: Add clamping to the selected variant's stock in the quantity input's blur/change handler, matching the logic that already disables the increase button.

failures.test: Product info › Add to Cart updates the header basket badge
failures.summary: The page load was blocked by a security policy (403), so the header and basket button never rendered.
failures.evidence: lastNavigation status 403; console: "Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 403 (Forbidden)"; snapshot: heading "Access denied" / "Your request was blocked by the security policy."
failures.next_step: Find out which WAF or rate-limit rule on the localhost:3100 target blocks the test runner, then allowlist the runner or relax that rule for test runs and rerun.

failures.test: Smoke: site health › home page renders with site chrome
failures.summary: The first navigation hit the 30s load timeout and the test passed on retry.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded. navigating to "http://localhost:3100/", waiting until "load" (outcome flaky, 2 attempts).
failures.next_step: Check server startup and warm-up for localhost:3100: make sure the server is fully up before tests start, or add a warm-up request.

failures.test: Product info › sizes that are out of stock for the colour are disabled
failures.summary: The beforeEach gotoProduct timed out waiting for the load event, even though the page had rendered, and the test passed on retry.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded at productPage.gotoProduct; the snapshot shows the full product page with status 200, but delivery still reads "Calculating delivery date".
failures.next_step: Identify the slow resource that delays the load event (for example the delivery-date call) and either fix it or have gotoProduct wait for 'domcontentloaded'.
